# SiliconPath

SiliconPath is a 100% free learning platform for VLSI and semiconductor engineers — no paywalls, no premium tiers, no course selling, no login required.

## Core Features
- 7 structured **VLSI Learning Academy** tracks with day-by-day curricula, practice quizzes, gated assessments, and embedded NPTEL + YouTube course videos per track.
- 15 career-focused **learning paths** (150 modules) spanning digital logic, Verilog, design verification, synthesis, physical design, static timing analysis, low power, DFT, and tools/career.
- **Free video course library** of 70 NPTEL courses and 4 YouTube playlists (Neso Academy, VLSI Academy) mapped per path and per academy track.
- **Engineering Lab** with real-world signoff violation debugging cases.
- **55 STA interview questions** with expandable engineering answers.
- OpenLane/Sky130 tapeout guide and career resources.

## Main Sections
- [Academy](https://siliconpath.in/academy): 7 structured curriculum tracks with embedded video lectures.
- [Learning Paths](https://siliconpath.in/learn): 15 paths / 150 modules.
- [Video Course Library](https://siliconpath.in/learn/video-courses): 74 curated free courses.
- [Engineering Lab](https://siliconpath.in/engineering-lab): signoff violation case studies.
- [STA Interview Questions](https://siliconpath.in/sta-interview-questions): 55 Q&A.
- [Courses & Guides](https://siliconpath.in/courses): tapeout guide, resume tips, career roadmap.
- [Resources](https://siliconpath.in/resources): VLSI role profiles and EDA toolchains.

## Target Audience
VLSI design, verification, physical design, DFT, and EDA engineers; students preparing for semiconductor careers.
